name: jsformvalidatorbundle
description: Client-side validation helpers generated from Symfony form validation metadata.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:build && start-server-and-test test:e2e:serve http://127.0.0.1:8000 test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:build: php Tests/app/bin/console assets:install Tests/app/public --env=test && npm --prefix Tests/app install && npm --prefix Tests/app run build
